summary: Verified the PRIMARY /dashboard deep-link guard end-to-end. Logged in via UI at /login with memberonly.trial@example.com / TrialTest123! after dismissing cookie consent banner. Login routed to /memberships (module-aware login). Then deep-linked browser to /dashboard via page.goto — app correctly redirected back to /memberships and stayed there after extra wait. Guard works as expected. SECONDARY Lite supplier-badge parity test was skipped per request (no easy way to produce a lite/pulse_pro account with supplier_case-populated fault in this session).
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardRoute guard in AppRoutes.js correctly redirects when user.module_access.operations is false and previewAsOperator is false — verified by UI deep-link.
moduleHomePath(user) returns /memberships for primary_module=memberships — verified by post-login landing + post-deep-link redirect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The login form's email input does NOT reliably accept Playwright's .fill() — first attempt left email empty while password was filled. Use page.keyboard.type(...) with explicit click() and a small per-key delay after dismissing the 'Accept All' cookie banner. Cookie banner must be dismissed BEFORE filling because it can re-render the form and reset autoFocus state.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bug found. Both module-aware login routing and the /dashboard deep-link guard are functioning correctly for memberships-only trial users.
